responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/sorted_map/index_map.rs: Defines `SortedIndexMultiMap`, a sorted-map variant that stores `(K, V)` entries in insertion order while maintaining a separate key-sorted index for efficient key-based lookup.
